title: Recursive formula for block counts
statement: For natural numbers $q,K$, a predicate $B$ on finite bit strings, and a finite bit string $l$, the number of the first $K+1$ consecutive length-$q$ blocks of $l$ satisfying $B$ equals $1$ if the first length-$q$ prefix of $l$ satisfies $B$, and $0$ otherwise, plus the number of the first $K$ consecutive length-$q$ blocks of the string obtained by dropping the first $q$ bits of $l$.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate $B$ on finite bit strings
